name: pmd-agents
description: A local Pokemon Mystery Dungeon guild for your coding agents

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Local observation and hook setup require a trusted workspace.

commands.title: PMD Agents: Set Up Provider Hooks

pmdAgents.assetPath.description: Local PMD pack directory containing manifest.json. Game artwork is imported separately.

pmdAgents.observeLocalChats.description: Read recent local Codex/Claude activity metadata for workspace chats. Text stays local and is discarded. Attachment follows the workspace auto-connect and auto-attach settings. Disabling pauses observation immediately.

pmdAgents.autoConnect.description: Automatically include supported recent chats from this workspace. This is workspace scope, not proof of native-chat window ownership. Automatic attachment pauses if another PMD Agents window has overlapping folders. Removed sessions stay excluded.

pmdAgents.autoAttach.description: Spawn a Pokémon for every discovered session as it appears, including hook events without a window token. This does not prove which window owns a chat. It pauses while another PMD Agents window has overlapping folders. Removed sessions stay excluded.

pmdAgents.favorites.markdownDescription: Favourite Pokémon, highest priority first, as Pokédex form ids (for example `appletun` or `pawmot-shiny`). A new teammate gets the first favourite no active teammate is using, then a random unused species. Edit them in the Pokémon storage system's **Favorites** tab; missing ones import automatically.

pmdAgents.autoShowWidget.description: Reveal the PMD sidebar widget once when each trusted VS Code window starts, without taking keyboard focus. Turn off to keep your saved sidebar visibility.

pmdAgents.desktopWidget.description: On Windows x64, keep this window's guild in an always-on-top desktop widget when VS Code is minimized. Minimizing the widget hides it until you show it or minimize VS Code again.

pmdAgents.desktopWidgetWidth.description: Width in pixels of the desktop widget whenever it opens. Its position is remembered per workspace; its size always starts here.

pmdAgents.desktopWidgetHeight.description: Height in pixels of the desktop widget whenever it opens.
